description: Live status of a flight to or from Taiwan: scheduled, estimated and actual times, delay, terminal, gate and status (on time, delayed, departed, cancelled, ...). TDX lists flights around today. Example: flight "CI100"; or "B7 8751".

date.description: Only this flight date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: every date TDX lists).

flight.description: Flight number with its airline code, e.g. "CI100", "BR 857", "AE1262".

name: flight_status
title: Flight status
